text:
marta: FYI vendor shipped a price update for 'PricePilot' (id=PP-2026-7). We need to validate coupon & grandfathering behavior before any rollouts. Sheet: https://vendor.example.com/sheets/PP-2026-7
liam: Quick check  does this change any reserved SKU pricing or only PAYG metering?
sophia: Also need to ensure legacy promo codes keep current discounts (no silent remap).
marta: PAYG only. Invoice line rename + adjusted token tiers. Grandfathering flags expected to remain.
devin: Pulled mapping sample. Edge cases: percent-off coupons, invoice_override=true, and accounts with custom billing cycles. Sample: ```acct,legacy_grandfathered,apply_new
40021,true,false
40022,false,true```
marta: @billing-bot run cohort preview "pp-pricepilot-exp" (~7k accounts): return invoice delta histogram, coupon collision rate, and top-20 anomalies.
billing-bot: queued preview job_id=jb_pp_01. ETA ~8m; will post summary link when ready.
cara: Legal found a bespoke termination sentence in the vendor doc. I've asked them to remove it; not blocking preview.
billing-bot: preview complete job_id=jb_pp_01. Summary: cohort_B median +1.7% invoice; coupon collision 0.07%; anomalies: 9 accounts with >$1k negative delta (proration edge). Report: https://internal/reports/jb_pp_01
liam: Running exposure calc now. If negative delta exposure > $30k we require finance convene.
sophia: I'll prepare A/B cohorts stratified by revenue deciles; will also output list of grandfathered accounts. ETA 2h.
devin: I can push a translation-table fix to address proration; request permission to test in canary.
marta: Approved to patch in canary and validate. Abort criteria: coupon collision >0.5% OR >50 accounts >$1k delta.
nate: Sales wants a short FAQ about grandfathering behavior and comms language if we flip. I'll draft once cohorts are final.
marta: Great. Post runbook in #release-war-room once hotfix validated. Keep updates here.
